disputes.reason: Ambiguous and arguably true as written: in a one-way CSA the posting party does have a zero threshold (the non-poster has the infinite one), so a candidate could defend it; the statement does not say which party.

Ambiguous: 'the counterparty' is unspecified (link to the buyer? to the seller?), and the claim that the seller then faces 'right-way' risk is contestable; the statement cannot be judged cleanly without the Oracle/sovereign scenario.
